text: Rosa needs a refill.

an agentic flow running on Rosso CTL.

Sentry tracks the data through each one
and checks it against company policy.
One it marks as risky, let's see why.
Sentry is data governance in Rosso CTL,
built on lineage, classification, and risk assessment.
Let's take one rule from the company policy.
Personal data must not leave the organization for an external target.
Level 1.
In Rosa's record, the context is all there.
Her name and beside it her medical record number.
Both are personal data.
Sending them to an external vendor breaks the policy,
so Sentry blocks it.
With full context at the point of decision,
this is local enforcement.

Level 2.

At release, it's out of context,
so given only the local context,
it's classified as a generic operational ID.

Four hops back, that number was Rosa's medical record number.

and it's blocked.
With full context Sentry blocks,
four hops downstream and out of context,
it still catches the leak.
